subject: general
question:
Select the correct order of Panchayat Institution titles according to the given sequence of their respective designation.

Chairperson of Gram Panchayat, Chairperson of Panchayat Samiti, Chairperson of Zila Parishad
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mukhiya, Pramukh, Adhyaksha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mukhiya** is the title for the Chairperson of Gram Panchayat, the basic unit of Panchayat Raj Institutions in India.
 
• **Pramukh** is the title for the Chairperson of Panchayat Samiti, which functions at the block level in the Panchayat Raj system.
 
• **Adhyaksha** is the title for the Chairperson of Zila Parishad, which operates at the district level in the Panchayat Raj framework.
 
• The Panchayat Raj Institutions are a decentralized form of governance in which gram panchayats are the basic units of administration.
 
• The system was formalized through the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992, which aimed at empowering local self-governments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayati Raj System:** It is a three-tier system of governance in rural India comprising Gram Panchayat (village level), Panchayat Samiti (block level), and Zila Parishad (district level).
 
• **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act:** This amendment, enacted in 1992, provided a constitutional status to the Panchayati Raj institutions and aimed at promoting decentralization of power.
 
• **Gram Sabha:** It is a key component of the Panchayati Raj system, consisting of all the registered voters in a village. It serves as the decision-making body at the village level.
 
• **Functions of Panchayat Institutions:** These include local administration, implementation of government schemes, and development activities such as water supply, sanitation, education, and health services.
 
• **Funding:** Panchayati Raj Institutions are funded through grants from the central and state governments, local taxes, and other sources like property tax and professional tax.
